subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio history-enrichment mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, inheritance, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change intentionally sends unmentioned speech through STT and makes derived text available to later model context, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Define scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, provider-cost bounds, schema/docs, and focused skipped-history tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this open as product input until maintainers define a cross-channel policy for retained unmentioned media and transcripts.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior if unmentioned Discord speech should not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, provider-cost bounds, schema/docs, and focused skipped-history tests before implementation.
